fields.rationale: TileLink is not an 8-bit byte-oriented command protocol. It is a 5-channel concurrent ready/valid protocol where 'commands' are encoded as multi-bit field tuples on each channel's opcode + param + size + source + address. Each channel has an independent opcode namespace; the same opcode value (e.g. 6) can carry different meanings on different channels.

channel_a_opcodes.description: Full-beat write. mask must be HIGH on all active byte lanes.
Byte-strobed write. mask selects byte lanes individually.
Atomic read-modify-write arithmetic. param selects {MIN, MAX, MINU, MAXU, ADD}.
Atomic read-modify-write bitwise logical. param selects {XOR, OR, AND, SWAP}.
Read from address range. data field is ignored.
TL-C only. Cache permission upgrade. param from Grow category {NtoB, NtoT, BtoT}.

channel_b_opcodes.description: Slave-to-master full-beat write to cached block.
Slave-to-master byte-strobed write to cached block.
Slave-to-master atomic arithmetic on cached block.
Slave-to-master atomic logical on cached block.
Slave-to-master hint to a cached block.
TL-C only. Slave revokes/caps master's permissions on a cache block. param from Cap category {toN, toB, toT}.

channel_c_opcodes.description: Master-side response to slave's PutFullData/PutPartialData on channel B.
Master-side response with data to slave's Get/Atomic on channel B.
Master-side response to slave's Intent on channel B.
TL-C. Master acknowledges Probe; param from Shrink or Report category {TtoB, TtoN, BtoN, TtoT, BtoB, NtoN}.
TL-C. Master acknowledges Probe and writes back dirty data.
TL-C. Master voluntarily releases permissions back to slave. param from Prune category {TtoB, TtoN, BtoN}.
TL-C. Master voluntarily releases permissions AND writes back dirty data.

channel_d_opcodes.description: Slave-side response to Put on channel A; carries no data.
Slave-side response to Get/Atomic on channel A; carries data.
Slave-side response to Intent on channel A.
TL-C. Slave grants permissions without data; param from Cap category {toT, toB, toN}.
TL-C. Slave grants permissions and provides the cache block data.

channel_e_opcodes.description: TL-C. Channel E carries only e_sink + e_valid + e_ready (no opcode field). Used to acknowledge Grant/GrantData and serialize TL-C transactions.

param_field_arithmeticdata.name: MIN
param_field_arithmeticdata.effect: Write the signed minimum of the two operands, and return the old value.

param_field_arithmeticdata.name: MAX
param_field_arithmeticdata.effect: Write the signed maximum of the two operands, and return the old value.

param_field_arithmeticdata.name: MINU
param_field_arithmeticdata.effect: Write the unsigned minimum of the two operands, and return the old value.

param_field_arithmeticdata.name: MAXU
param_field_arithmeticdata.effect: Write the unsigned maximum of the two operands, and return the old value.

param_field_arithmeticdata.name: ADD
param_field_arithmeticdata.effect: Write the sum of the two operands, and return the old value.

param_field_logicaldata.name: XOR
param_field_logicaldata.effect: Bitwise logical XOR of the two operands; write result, return old value.

param_field_logicaldata.name: OR
param_field_logicaldata.effect: Bitwise logical OR of the two operands; write result, return old value.

param_field_logicaldata.name: AND
param_field_logicaldata.effect: Bitwise logical AND of the two operands; write result, return old value.

param_field_logicaldata.name: SWAP
param_field_logicaldata.effect: Swap the two operands and return the old value.

param_field_intent.name: PrefetchRead
param_field_intent.effect: Issuing agent intends to read target data.

param_field_intent.name: PrefetchWrite
param_field_intent.effect: Issuing agent intends to write target data.
